name: Anders Larsson Memorial 2017
information:
With this competition we remember our friend Anders Larsson, who did so many good things for WCA. During the competition we will have special moments to bring back good memories of Anders. We will also host the 'solving with feet' event, as this event was specifically requested by Anders to become an official event.

Payment of registration fee of 50SEK will take place on-site on the day of the competition.
